correctness.rationale: Exact finite directed Reed–Frost ancestor-set probabilities are P(K=1)=(1-p)^2, P(K=2)=2p(1-p)^2, and P(K=3)=p^2(3-2p). Substitution into F1,F2,F3 gives D3=pq(q-1)[2+6p-6p^2-q(9p-6p^2)], including q_c=(2+6p-6p^2)/(9p-6p^2) only for p>2/3. D2=-2pq(1-q)<0. For n>=3, the r=1-q coefficient in Dn is p(1-p)^(n-3)(np-2), leaving np=2 intentionally undecided. Independent exhaustive enumeration of all directed contact graphs and seed masks at (p,q)=(9/10,1/2),(9/10,9/10),(2/5,4/5) gave D3=-207/1000,3807/125000,-1328/15625 respectively. All quantifiers and endpoints are respected.
